Seed journeys complete!

Dandelion seeds sail on the wind, coconuts float on water, and burrs hitch-hike on fur!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Seed travel explains why plants pop up in odd places. Blow a real dandelion, then check your socks for hitch-hikers after a walk — both are the same science.
